title: Get Shop Video Performance Details
content:
# Path: /analytics/202509/shop_videos/{video_id}/performance
# Method: [GET]
# Function Description
Returns detailed performance metrics for a (requested) video.

---


# Common Parameters
For common parameters, refer to [How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/64f199679495ef0281851ee5#Back%20To%20Top)
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Location <!-- width:75px --> | Type <!-- width:75px --> | Require <!-- width:60px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| shop_cipher | query | string | Y | GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 | Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. |
| Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9) |  |  |  |  |  |
| content-type | header | string | Y | application/json | Allowed type: application/json |
# Request Path Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| video_id | string | Y | 7523456789012345678 | The ID of the shop video whose performance details are requested. |
# Request Query Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Require <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:254px --> | Properties description <!-- width:254px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| app_key | string | Y | 38abcd | Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app. |
| sign | string | Y | 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c | Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders. |
| timestamp | int | Y | 1623812664 | Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |
| start_date_ge | string | Y | 2024-09-01 | Start date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone. |
| In the parameter name, "ge" refers to "greater than or equal to" (inclusive) |  |  |  |  |
The time range between start and end must not exceed 60 days. |
end_date_lt |string |Y |2024-09-08 |End date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone.
In the parameter name, "lt" refers to "less than" (exclusive)
The time range between start and end must not exceed 60 days. |
granularity |string |N |ALL |Granularity of the data.
Available values: ALL, 1D
Default value: ALL

* ALL: aggregate
* 1D: daily |
   currency |string |N |USD |Currently, only local currency is supported in the response.

Available values: USD, LOCAL
Default value: LOCAL

* USD: US dollars
* LOCAL: local currency where the shop is located |

# Request Sample
**Query**
```Plain Text
https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/analytics/202509/shop_videos/7523456789012345678/performance?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&start_date_ge=2024-09-01&end_date_lt=2024-09-08&granularity=ALL&currency=USD
```

# Response Parameters
| Properties <!-- width:110px --> | Type <!-- width:90px --> | Sample <!-- width:289px --> | Properties description <!-- width:289px --> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| code | int | 0 | The success or failure status code returned in API response. |
| message | string | Success | The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message. |
| request_id | string | 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 | Request log |
| data | object |  | Specific return information |
| ^performance | object |  | Overall performance data for the video. |
| ^^intervals | []object |  | Interval data for the requested time range. The time range of each interval is determined by the granularity. |
| ^^^start_date | string | 2024-09-01 | Start date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, inclusive. |
| ^^^end_date | string | 2024-09-08 | End date of the interval (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD format) in shop registered timezone, exclusive. |
| ^^^sales | object |  | Sale performance data. |
| ^^^^overall | object |  | Overall performance |
| ^^^^^gmv | object |  | The total amount paid for orders placed directly from the shoppable video, including returns and refunds. |
| ^^^^^^amount | string | 230.02 | GMV amount in the corresponding currency. |
| ^^^^^^currency | string | USD | GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP). |
| ^^^^^gpm | object |  | The avg. video GPM is the average GMV generated from 1,000 impressions of the Video. |
| ^^^^^^amount | string | 1.02 | GPM amount in the corresponding currency. |
| ^^^^^^currency | string | USD | GPM currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP). |
| ^^^^^customers | int | 12 | The total number of customers who placed orders directly from the shoppable video. |
| ^^^^^items_sold | int | 22 | The total number of items sold directly from the shoppable video. |
| ^^^^^ctr | string | 0.029 | Ratio of product clicks from the video to impressions of all products in the video, expressed as a decimal fraction. |
| ^^^^^product_impressions | int | 32092 | The number of impressions of all video products |
| ^^^^^product_clicks | int | 21232 | The number of product clicks from the video |
| ^^^^breakdowns | []object |  | Breakdown data for product-level sales performance in each interval. |
| ^^^^^product_id | string | 19332235 | Id of the product linked to this video |
| ^^^^^gmv | object |  | Gross merchandise value (GMV) for this product in the interval. |
| ^^^^^^amount | string | 230.02 | GMV amount in the corresponding currency. |
| ^^^^^^currency | string | USD | GMV currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP). |
| ^^^^^gpm | object |  | Average GMV generated for this product per 1,000 video impressions in the interval. |
| ^^^^^^amount | string | 1.02 | GPM amount in the corresponding currency. |
| ^^^^^^currency | string | USD | GPM currency code (ISO 4217 standard). If LOCAL currency is requested, the value will be the local currency code of where the shop is registered (e.g. GBP). |
| ^^^^^customers | int | 12 | The total number of customers who placed orders directly from the shoppable video. |
| ^^^^^items_sold | int | 22 | The total number of items sold directly from the shoppable video. |
| ^^^^^ctr | string | 0.029 | The number of product clicks from the video / The number of impressions of all video products |
| ^^^^^product_impressions | int | 32092 | The number of impressions of all video products |
| ^^^^^product_clicks | int | 21232 | The number of product clicks from the video |
| ^^^traffic | object |  | Traffic performance of the video. |
| ^^^^views | int | 76649 | Number of times the requested video was watched during the interval. Repeat views by the same user are counted separately. |
| ^^^^new_followers | int | 11 | The number of times a user followed you after watching a video |
| ^^^^shares | int | 23 | The cumulative number of times users shared the video |
| ^^^^comments | int | 8 | The cumulative number of times users left comments on the video |
| ^^^^likes | int | 2 | The cumulative number of times users liked the video |
| ^^viewer_profile | []object |  | Viewer profile of the video |
| ^^^type | string | VIEWERS | Viewer profile type. Possible values: |

* NEW_FOLLOWER: viewers who newly followed after watching the video
* VIEWERS: viewers of the video |
   ^^^gender_distribution |[]object | |View gender distribution |
   ^^^^gender |string |MALE |Viewer gender. Possible values:
* MALE: male viewers
* FEMALE: female viewers |
   ^^^^percentage |string |0.349 |Proportion for the corresponding gender within this viewer profile, expressed as a decimal fraction. |
   ^^^age_distribution |[]object | |Viewer age distribution |
   ^^^^age |string |25-34 |Possible values:
* 18-24
* 25-34
* 35-44
* 45-54
* 55+ |
   ^^^^percentage |string |0.293 |Proportion for the corresponding age group within this viewer profile, expressed as a decimal fraction. |
   ^^^country_distribution |[]object | |Viewer country distribution. |
   ^^^^country_code |string |MY |The region of the viewer's TikTok account. |
   ^^^^percentage |string |0.993 |Proportion for the corresponding country within this viewer profile, expressed as a decimal fraction. |
   ^latest_available_date |string |2024-09-07 |Latest date in local timezone where data is ready (ISO 8601 format). |

# Response Sample
```json
{"code":0,"data":{"performance":{"intervals":[{"start_date":"2024-09-01","end_date":"2024-09-08","sales":{"overall":{"gmv":{"amount":"230.02","currency":"USD"},"gpm":{"amount":"1.02","currency":"USD"},"customers":12,"items_sold":22,"ctr":"0.029","product_impressions":32092,"product_clicks":21232},"breakdowns":[{"product_id":"19332235","gmv":{"amount":"230.02","currency":"USD"},"gpm":{"amount":"1.02","currency":"USD"},"customers":12,"items_sold":22,"ctr":"0.029","product_impressions":32092,"product_clicks":21232}]},"traffic":{"views":76649,"new_followers":11,"shares":23,"comments":8,"likes":2}}],"viewer_profile":[{"type":"VIEWERS","gender_distribution":[{"gender":"MALE","percentage":"0.349"}],"age_distribution":[{"age":"25-34","percentage":"0.293"}],"country_distribution":[{"country_code":"MY","percentage":"0.993"}]}]},"latest_available_date":"2024-09-07"},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}
```
